description: Lists the available documentation versions and the default one, plus where to look for the user's version-edition-product. Use it if you don't know what value to pass for 'version'. It does NOT establish the user's deployment: for the procedure that does, and for the snippet that pins the result in their AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, call 'resolve_openvidu_version_edition_product'.
name: list_versions
title: List documentation versions
